title: land and dispatch name a host item's branch and merge request by the kb id, so a workspace whose repositories enforce their own task-id branch and MR-title rules cannot land (Nerthus adoption)
goal: backlog.json takes a naming setting, one object of templates (branch, mr_title, trailer) filled from the item: {id} its id, {task} its first external id (P08-05), {nn} and {mm} that id's two digit runs, {title} its title, {slug} the title as a branch word; dispatch makes each repository's worktree on the branch template (proj/{nn}-{mm}-{slug}); land reads each repository's merge request by the mr_title template's text up to the title ('{task}:'); the worker's brief tells it to end each commit in a repository with the trailer template ('Task: {task}'); with no naming set the kb's work/<id> and '<id>:' stay the default; the workspace's own branch stays work/<id>

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); R=lambda *a: subprocess.run(a,cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True); R('git','init','-q','-b','main','.'); R('git','config','user.email','a@b.c'); R('git','config','user.name','x'); os.makedirs(d+'/api'); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q','-b','main',d+'/api']); cfg={'item_dir':'items','repositories':{'api':'api'},'trackers':{'nerthus':{'pattern':'P[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}','url':'https://t.example.com/{id}'}}}; json.dump(cfg,open(d+'/backlog.json','w')); R('git','add','backlog.json'); R('git','commit','-qm','init'); B=[sys.executable,os.path.abspath('_tools/backlog.py'),'--root',d]; subprocess.run(B+['new','story','--title','Add rate limit','--goal','g','--touch','api/**','--external','nerthus=P08-05','--check','python3 _tools/x.py'],capture_output=True,text=True); iid=os.listdir(d+'/items')[0][:-5]; subprocess.run(B+['set',iid,'--repos','api'],capture_output=True,text=True); cfg['naming']={'branch':'proj/{nn}-{mm}-{slug}','mr_title':'{task}: {title}','trailer':'Task: {task}'}; json.dump(cfg,open(d+'/backlog.json','w')); o=subprocess.run(B+['dispatch',iid,'--dry-run'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; ls=[l[-80:] for l in o.splitlines() if l.startswith('worktree of api')]; print(ls); sys.exit(0 if ls and 'proj/08-05-add-rate-limit' in ls[0] else 1)

notes: Measured on the Nerthus workspace: land of a story whose task (P08-05) has a merged '<task id>:' request stops at step requests with "no merge request titled 'ST-dl7mgwpd:' (state none)", and done refuses the item (the work of an item with repos is merged in its repositories, which land reads through their merge requests), so a host whose requests carry its own ids has no landing path. Planned to the operator's answer (one naming object of templates).
